definitions.gloss: previous graduate; person who has already graduated
definitions.explanation: A person who has already graduated from school but has not yet secured employment. In the Japanese job market, this term specifically refers to graduates who missed the standard new-graduate hiring cycle.

examples.japanese: {既卒|きそつ}{向|む}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{求人|きゅうじん}→求人：04690_kyuujin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for job postings for previous graduates.

examples.japanese: {既卒|きそつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: More companies are accepting applications from previous graduates.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新卒|しんそつ}→新卒：12871_shinsotsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧⟦できなかった→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{既卒|きそつ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}{活動|かつどう}→就職活動：14840_shuushokukatsudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Since I couldn't get a job as a new graduate, I'm continuing my job search as a previous graduate.

notes:
USAGE:
{既卒|きそつ} is a job-market term specific to Japan's hiring system. Japanese companies traditionally hire ⟦{新卒|しんそつ}→新卒：12871_shinsotsu⟧ (new graduates) in a standardized annual cycle. Those who graduate without landing a job are classified as {既卒|きそつ} and may face disadvantages in the hiring process, though this has been gradually changing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {既卒|きそつ}⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧ (hiring of previous graduates)
- {既卒|きそつ}{向|む}け (aimed at previous graduates)
- {既卒|きそつ}{者|しゃ} (previous graduate — as a person)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{新卒|しんそつ}→新卒：12871_shinsotsu⟧ — new graduate (graduating in the current academic year)
- {既卒|きそつ} — previous graduate (already graduated, not yet employed)
- {第二新卒|だいにしんそつ} — someone who left their first job within a few years
